pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against pyramiding or adding concurrent tickets within 5 minutes of a prior entry in the same directional bias.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated ATR-based volatility buffer and volume confirmation filter prior to market order authorization to avoid liquidity wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively lock in gains once floating profit reaches +$15.00 using trailing micro-stops, preventing wins from evaporating.
